idea-plugin.name: Markdown Review
idea-plugin.description:
Review changes in Markdown files in rendered form, inside IntelliJ's own diff window:
  • side-by-side rendered diff: removed blocks on red, added on green, changed words highlighted;
  • merged view: one column, removals struck through, additions in green;
  • the built-in text diff one click away;
  • works for local changes, history, branch comparison and pull requests, plus Compare Markdown Files... for any two files.
